office: the Department of Immigration and Citizenship Services

routes.label: at an immigration office (Blantyre, Lilongwe or Mzuzu), applied for online

note: The Department's pages give each passport's validity but no fee; it's paid at the Malawi Savings Bank within the immigration office. The current fee and the processing time are leads (epassport.gov.mw renders nothing to this client; the press found only gives fees from before the kwacha's devaluations).

sources.title: Department of Immigration and Citizenship Services, Malawi, Types of Passport
sources.said: 1. Ordinary Passport Any eligible Malawian is entitled to this Passport which is valid for 10 Years. ... Child Passport » A child passport is valid for 5 years and is issued to children under the age of 10 years.

sources.title: Department of Immigration and Citizenship Services, Malawi, Passport Process
sources.said: Present himself or herself at one of the following Immigration Offices ; Blantyre, Lilongwe and Mzuzu depending on where the applicant is residing for easy follow up and be subjected to thorough interviews by the Immigration Officer at the counter.The applicant will also have his/her biometrics (picture, fingerprints and signature) captured live and finally pay for the passport at the Malawi Savings Bank located within the Immigration Offices.
